Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there are no distinct ranges that stand out as anomalies. The data exhibits consistent noise and fluctuation throughout the entire x-axis range (0 to ~730). While there are individual spikes (e.g., around x=65, x=170, x=305, x=490, x=530, x=570), they appear as isolated points rather than sustained anomalous ranges or shifts in behavior. Therefore, no specific intervals can be confidently classified as anomaly ranges.
